name: new
desc: Start a new session (fresh session ID + history)

name: save
desc: Export the current conversation (bare /save shows usage)

name: retry
desc: Retry the last message (resend to agent)

name: undo
desc: Back up N user turns and re-prompt (default 1)

name: title
desc: Set a title for the current session

name: branch
desc: Branch the current session (new thread on Discord/Telegram/Slack/Matrix; --here stays here)

name: compress
desc: Compress conversation context (add 'here [N]' to keep recent N turns; --preview shows what would happen)

name: rollback
desc: List or restore filesystem checkpoints (restores keep your hand-edits; --all overrides)

name: stop
desc: Kill all running background processes

name: discard
desc: Drop a turn lost when Hermes restarted so this chat's queue runs again

name: pause
desc: Pause new work globally (emergency stop); '/pause off' resumes

name: approve
desc: Approve a pending dangerous command

name: deny
desc: Deny a pending dangerous command (optionally with a reason)

name: bg
desc: Run a prompt in a separate background session

name: btw
desc: Ask a side question about the current conversation without interrupting it

name: agents
desc: Show active agents and running tasks

name: queue
desc: Queue a prompt for the next turn, or list/edit/rm/move/clear queued prompts

name: steer
desc: Inject a message after the next tool call without interrupting

name: goal
desc: Set a standing goal Hermes works on across turns until achieved
args: [text | -- <text> | draft <text> | show | gate add <cmd> | pause | resume | clear | status | wait <pid> | unwait]

name: heartbeat
desc: Set a recurring prompt that re-enters this session when idle

name: refine
desc: Review this conversation now and save lessons to memory/skills

name: review
desc: Spawn an independent subagent to review the work just discussed (PR, code, docs)

name: loop
desc: Re-run a prompt on a recurring interval in this session

name: plan
desc: Write a markdown implementation plan to .hermes/plans/ without executing anything

name: moa
desc: Run one prompt through the default Mixture of Agents preset, then restore your model

name: subgoal
desc: Add or manage extra criteria on the active goal

name: status
desc: Show session, model, token, and context info

name: egress
desc: Show Docker egress proxy status

name: context
desc: Show detailed context window view with usage gauge, category breakdown, compression stats, and throughput

name: whoami
desc: Show your slash command access (admin / user)

name: profile
desc: Show active profile name and home directory

name: sethome
desc: Set this chat as the home channel

name: resume
desc: Resume a previously-named session

name: sessions
desc: Browse and resume previous sessions

name: model
desc: Switch model (session-scoped; --global to persist)

name: codex-runtime
desc: Toggle codex app-server runtime for OpenAI/Codex models

name: personality
desc: Set a predefined personality

name: diff
desc: Show git changes in the working directory

name: footer
desc: Toggle gateway runtime-metadata footer on final replies

name: yolo
desc: Toggle YOLO mode (skip all dangerous command approvals)

name: approvals
desc: Show or set the persistent dangerous-command approval mode

name: reasoning
desc: Manage reasoning effort and display

name: fast
desc: Fast mode — OpenAI Priority Processing / Anthropic Fast Mode (normal/fast/auto/cold/ultrafast)

name: voice
desc: Toggle voice mode

name: busy
desc: Control how messages behave while Hermes is working

name: autoprune
desc: Turn automatic pruning of old sessions on or off

name: memory
desc: Review pending memory writes / toggle the approval gate

name: bundles
desc: List skill bundles (aliases /<name> for multiple skills)

name: learn
desc: Learn a reusable skill from anything you describe (dirs, URLs, this chat, notes)

name: init
desc: Generate or update AGENTS.md project instructions from a repo scan

name: suggestions
desc: Review suggested automations (accept/dismiss)

name: blueprint
desc: Set up an automation from a blueprint template

name: curator
desc: Background skill maintenance (status, run, pin, archive, list-archived)

name: kanban
desc: Multi-profile collaboration board (tasks, links, comments)

name: reload-mcp
desc: Reload MCP servers from config

name: reload-skills
desc: Re-scan ~/.hermes/skills/ for newly installed or removed skills

name: commands
desc: Browse all commands and skills (paginated)

name: help
desc: Show available commands (/help skills lists skill commands, /help <text> filters)

name: restart
desc: Gracefully restart the gateway after draining active runs

name: usage
desc: Show token usage and rate limits; `reset` redeems a banked Codex limit reset

name: login
desc: Sign in with a Nous account (keeps your connectors)

name: topup
desc: Show your Nous balance and manage billing on the portal

name: insights
desc: Show usage insights and analytics

name: platform
desc: Pause, resume, or list a failing gateway platform

name: update
desc: Update Hermes Agent to the latest version

name: version
desc: Show Hermes Agent version

name: debug
desc: Upload debug report (system info + logs) and get shareable links
